## Source

Paste the smallest Markdown/HTML input that reproduces the issue.

## Expected and actual output

Include renderer version, browser/host, enabled capabilities, and comparison renderer if relevant.

## Stream chunks

Show chunk boundaries, whether the stream finished or was interrupted, and whether user state changed.

## Reproduction

Provide steps or a fixture. Remove private text, credentials, and sensitive resource URLs.
